questions.question: Choose the correct form of the verb in brackets to complete the sentence: She said that she _____ to the cinema the following week.
Select the correct reported speech form: 'I really enjoyed that film,' he said to me.
options: He said that he had really enjoyed that film.
He said that he really enjoyed that film.
He said to me that he had really enjoyed that film.
He said to me that he really enjoyed that film.
questions.answer: He said to me that he really enjoyed that film.

questions.question: Which option correctly uses the passive voice? The report suggests that the project _____ completed by Friday.
options: will be able to have been
will be able to be completed
will be able to have been completed
questions.answer: will be able to be completed

questions.question: Identify the correct collocation: We need to _____ the meeting because of the urgent matter.
Choose the appropriate discourse marker to complete the sentence: _____ I'm sure you'll agree, this proposal has several benefits.
Select the correct form to complete the sentence: If I _____ more time, I would have finished the report.
Which sentence correctly uses the third conditional? We wish that we _____ the concert last night.
Identify the correct preposition to complete the phrase: 'It's not my cup of tea.'
Choose the best word to complete the sentence: The government is trying to _____ inflation through new economic policies.
Which option correctly reports the indirect question? She asked me where I had been the previous day.
options: She asked me where I had been the previous day.
She asked me where I had been the day before.
She asked me where I was the previous day.
She asked me where I have been the previous day.
questions.answer: She asked me where I had been the day before.
